title: Match-3 Mechanics: Crafting Satisfaction via Score Curves and Constraint Strategies
subtitle: This guide dissects the non-linear mapping between chain length and score in match-3 games, detailing technical implementations for blocking infinite chains through dynamic generation and movement constraints. It further explains how to calibrate feedback timing to sustain player engagement, equipping developers with tools for numerical balancing and level pacing.
